decision.reasoning_trace: In evaluating the product feed, I prioritized actual backpacks over accessories like rain covers, carabiners, or camping gear that were miscategorized or mixed in. I selected a consideration set that represents diverse use cases: the QT&QY tactical pack for heavy-duty use, the ZOMAKE for lightweight travel, the TOURIT for picnic/cooler needs, the Piscifun for waterproof/dry bag needs, and the Rawlings for specialized sports gear. I ultimately chose the QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) because it offers the best combination of high ratings (4.7), high review volume (over 6,000 reviews), and functional versatility at a competitive price point ($39.99).
